run_email_agent_cli: run the email agent CLI with --email flag to interact with Gmail via Llama 3.1
list_emails: list emails from Gmail matching an optional query string with sender, subject, and time
send_email_compose_reply_forward: compose, reply to, or forward an email via the Gmail API with a given recipient and body
get_email_detail_body_attachment: get the body text or attachment details of a specific email by message ID or position
create_draft_new_reply_forward: create a new email draft, reply draft, or forward draft in Gmail without sending it
